profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: Hands-on developer that believes in creating high quality software that is well-designed, thoroughly tested, and easy to evolve and maintain.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Assisted the enterprise Bloomberg AIM department in the development of data pipelines that performed transformations used for position management and integrated analytics from another department PORT. Mainly using C++, Python and many internal frameworks within Bloomberg.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Develop and maintain existing applications in the settlements space. Technologies used include Scala, Python and Javascript(React.js).

positions.title: Java/Scala Consultant
positions.description:
Worked as a consultant for Citi on a platform that assisted traders by making it easier to visualize trade information, client data and provided real-time information that helps traders make decisions and feed into automated trading systems. The platform used a wide variety of tools including Scala, Java, Spring, Kafka, Elastic Stack, Flink, and Akka.

Moved many applications and microservices to use an openshift/kubernetes cluster by setting many of the required configuration for dockerfiles, deployments, configmaps, secrets, etc.

Worked as a consultant Goldman Sachs where my role was gathering information from various data sources and that will be utilized to assess vulnerabilities in applications. The main technologies used consist mainly of Java, Spring, and Elasticsearch.

positions.title: Associate
positions.description:
Provided solutions to processing and storing gigabytes of data using Scala, Spark and the Cloudera stack. The main applications consisted of migrating and denormalizing data from relational databases and storing it on multiple distributed system and different Hadoop file formats using Spark as the processing engine. The data will be used by other teams for data science and machine learning. Multiple technologies were used such as Scala, Java, Spring, Hbase, Hadoop, the ELK(Elasticsearch, Logstash, and Kibana) stack, and many others.

Set up a Kubernetes cluster that was used to submit spark jobs and run services that automated multiple tasks to acquire and clean data before processing. I also developed services that can be used to manage some tasks more conveniently such as submitting spark jobs and caching daily data for quick queries using Gemfire.

positions.title: Programmer MKTS
positions.description:
-Designed and developed applications for Corporate Action processing in the Asset Services team.  Most applications were written using Scala, Python and Javascript. 
-Developed, enhanced, and maintained applications that support business units or functions in the Global Markets environment following established procedures.
-Mentored other developers to understand current applications and learn Scala.
-Created and maintained Ansible scripts and Jenkins.

positions.title: Web and Database Developer
positions.description:
-Develop software to get real-time data feeds from many transportation agencies, organize and store the data. The main technology used are Java, Node.js, and MongoDB.
-Create an interface that facilitates the analysis of the data
